title: passiflora ciliata var. orinocensis
intro: Passiflora ciliata var. orinocensis, commonly known as the Yellow Granadilla, is a species of passionflower native to the Orinoco region of South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Passiflora ciliata var. orinocensis include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids like quercetin and kaempferol, contribute to its therapeutic actions and may also have protective effects against oxidative stress and inflammation.
